_meta.note: Scenarios define the objective the player must satisfy. Objectives are checked by the engine against computed metrics.

objective_fields.metric: value computed by the simulation engine
objective_fields.weight: relative importance within the scenario (sums to 1.0)

scenarios.name: Climate Watch
scenarios.story: A climate agency needs continuous, comparable multispectral observations of land and ocean temperature for a 3-year climate record.

objectives.label: Multispectral imaging capability
objectives.explain: Sum of science value across imaging-category instruments.

objectives.label: Thermal observation capability
objectives.explain: Thermal IR or microwave radiometry on board.

objectives.label: Revisit time
objectives.explain: How often the satellite passes over the same target.

objectives.label: Mission lifetime
objectives.explain: Propellant-limited lifetime must cover the full record.

objectives.label: Data delivered
objectives.explain: Percent of generated data actually downlinked.

scenarios.hints: A medium bus, medium array, hires camera + thermal sounder in SSO 400 fits comfortably. Watch the 20 GB/day downlink problem.
scenarios.designer_note: Deliberately generous budget so the first playthrough is winnable.

scenarios.name: Disaster Response
scenarios.story: After a season of record floods, a regional government needs imagery within 6 hours of request — day or night, through cloud.

objectives.label: All-weather imaging
objectives.explain: SAR is the only instrument that sees through cloud and darkness.

objectives.label: Revisit time (single satellite)
objectives.explain: Floods move fast; a 12-hour revisit misses the peak. Sub-6h would need a constellation — out of scope.

objectives.label: Data delivered
objectives.explain: SAR generates 40 GB/day — downlink is the hard part.

scenarios.hints: SAR (180 W) + fast revisit forces either LEO 550 or a large array. Budget is tight: the Ka-band terminal may be worth more than a second science instrument.
scenarios.designer_note: The intended lesson: sometimes the enabling hardware (comms) beats more science.

scenarios.name: Space Weather Sentinel
scenarios.story: Aviation and power-grid operators need continuous monitoring of solar-wind particles and the geomagnetic field for 5 years.

objectives.label: Comm availability
objectives.explain: Alerts must reach the ground within minutes, not hours.

scenarios.hints: The comm requirement pushes you toward MEO or GEO — where radiation is high and lifetime is long. Plasma analyzer earns its keep here.
scenarios.designer_note: Teaches that orbit choice is driven by the objective, not by habit.
